newsitem.title: USA: Aubrey G Lanston names Alan Levenson VP research.
newsitem.headline: Aubrey G Lanston names Alan Levenson VP research.

text.p: Former UBS Securities money market economist Alan Levenson was named vice president and director of research at Aubrey G. Lanston, the firm said on Wednesday.
Levenson will be in charge of research prodcuts and marketing and will deal closely with trading and sales. He will concentrate on macro economic analysis.

"We are just delighted to have him," said David Jones, chief economist at Lanston. "I think he is an outstanding addition to the research department. He can give strong support to our research effort and customer."
Jones said he needed a solid and seasoned economist since he now has more corporate responsibilities now that he is vice chairman.
